yadi śabdāhvayaṃ jyotir āsaṃsāraṃ na dīpyate ||
teṣām asaṃnidhāne .pi na svayaṃ paśya naśyati ||
gaur gauḥ kāmadughā samyak prayuktā smaryate budhaiḥ |
duṣprayuktā punar gotvaṃ prayoktuḥ saiva śaṃsati ||
tad alpam api nopekṣyaṃ kāvye duṣṭaṃ kathaṃcana |
syād vapuḥ sundaram api śvitreṇaikena durbhagam ||
taiḥ śarīraṃ ca kāvyānām alaṃkārāś ca darśitāḥ |
padyaṃ gadyaṃ ca miśraṃ ca tat tridhaiva vyavasthitam |
padyaṃ catuṣpadī tac ca vṛttaṃ jātir iti dvidhā ||
sā vidyā naur vivikṣūṇāṃ gambhīraṃ kāvyasāgaram ||
muktakaṃ kulakaṃ kośaḥ saṃghāta iti tādṛśaḥ |
nyūnam apy atra yaiḥ kaiścid aṅgaiḥ kāvyaṃ na duṣyati |
guṇataḥ prāg upanyasya nāyakaṃ tena vidviṣām |
iti tasya prabhedau dvau tayor ākhyāyikā kila ||
api tv aniyamo dṛṣṭas tatrāpy anyair udīraṇāt |
anyo vaktā svayaṃ veti kīdṛg vā bhedalakṣaṇam ||
vaktraṃ cāparavaktraṃ ca socchvāsatvaṃ ca bhedakam |
cihnam ākhyāyikāyāś cet prasaṅgena kathāsv api ||
bhedaś ca dṛṣṭo lambhādir ucchvāso vāstu kiṃ tataḥ ||
mukham iṣṭārthasaṃsiddhyai kiṃ hi na syāt kṛtātmanām ||
tad etad vāṅmayaṃ bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ tathā |
apabhraṃśaś ca miśraṃ cety āhur āryāś caturvidham ||
saṃskṛtaṃ nāma daivī vāg anvākhyātā maharṣibhiḥ |
śaurasenī ca gauḍī ca lāṭī cānyā ca tādṛśī |
yāti prākṛtam ity evaṃ vyavahāreṣu saṃnidhim ||
śravyam eveti saiṣāpi dvayī gatir udāhṛtā ||
asty aneko girāṃ mārgaḥ sūkṣmabhedaḥ parasparam |
iti vaidarbhamārgasya prāṇā daśa guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
madhuraṃ rasavad vāci vastuny api rasasthitiḥ |
eṣa rājā yadā lakṣmīṃ prāptavān brāhmaṇapriyaḥ |
itīdaṃ nādṛtaṃ gauḍair anuprāsas tu tatpriyaḥ |
anuprāsād api prāyo vaidarbhair idam iṣyate ||
varṇāvṛttir anuprāsaḥ pādeṣu ca padeṣu ca |
cāru candramasaṃ bhīru bimbaṃ paśyaitad ambare |
smaraḥ kharaḥ khalaḥ kāntaḥ kāyaḥ kopaś ca naḥ kṛśaḥ |
cyuto māno .dhiko rāgo moho jāto .savo gatāḥ ||
tat tu naikāntamadhuram ataḥ paścād vidhāsyate ||
kāmaṃ sarvo .py alaṃkāro rasam arthe niṣiñcati |
kanye kāmayamānaṃ māṃ na tvaṃ kāmayase katham |
duṣpratītikaraṃ grāmyaṃ yathā yā bhavataḥ priyā ||
kharaṃ prahṛtya viśrāntaḥ puruṣo vīryavān iti |
evamādi na śaṃsanti mārgayor ubhayor api ||
dīptam ity aparair bhūmnā kṛcchrodyam api badhyate |
nyakṣeṇa kṣayitaḥ pakṣaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ kṣaṇād iti ||
nedṛśaṃ bahu manyate mārgayor ubhayor api |
utkarṣavān guṇaḥ kaścid yasminn ukte pratīyate |
arthināṃ kṛpaṇā dṛṣṭis tvanmukhe patitā sakṛt |
tadavasthā punar deva nānyasya mukham īkṣate ||
iti tyāgasya vākye .sminn utkarṣaḥ sādhu lakṣyate |
ślāghyair viśeṣaṇair yuktam udāraṃ kaiścid iṣyate |
iti padye .pi paurastyā badhnanty ojasvinīr giraḥ |
anye tv anākulaṃ hṛdyam icchanty ojo girāṃ yathā ||
kasya kāmāturaṃ ceto vāruṇī na kariṣyati ||
gṛhāṇi nāma tāny eva taporāśir bhavādṛśaḥ |
yo .rthas tenāti tuṣyanti vidagdhā netare janāḥ ||
idam atyuktir ity uktam etad gauḍopalālitam |
prasthānaṃ prākpraṇītaṃ tu sāram anyasya vartmanaḥ ||
samyag ādhīyate yatra sa samādhiḥ smṛto yathā ||
iti hṛdyam ahṛdyaṃ tu niḥṣṭhīvati vadhūr iti |
yugapan naikadharmāṇām adhyāsaś ca smṛto yathā ||
tad etat kāvyasarvasvaṃ samādhir nāma yo guṇaḥ |
tadbhedās tu na śakyante vaktuṃ pratikavi sthitāḥ ||
tathāpi na tad ākhyātuṃ sarasvatyāpi śakyate ||
naisargikī ca pratibhā śrutaṃ ca bahu nirmalam |
na vidyate yady api pūrvavāsanāguṇānubandhi pratibhānam adbhutam |
śrutena yatnena ca vāg upāsitā dhruvaṃ karoty eva kamapy anugraham ||
tadastatandrair aniśaṃ sarasvatī śramād upāsyā khalu kīrtim īpsubhiḥ |
kṛśe kavitve .pi janāḥ kṛtaśramāḥ vidagdhagoṣṭhīṣu vihartum īśate ||
te cādyāpi vikalpyante kas tān kārtsnyena vakṣyati ||
svabhāvoktiś ca jātiś cety ādyā sālaṃkṛtir yathā ||
śāstreṣvasyaiva sāmrājyaṃ kāvyeṣv apy etad īpsitam ||
upamā nāma sā tasyāḥ prapañco .yaṃ nidarśyate ||
rājīvam iva te vaktraṃ netre nīlotpale iva |
tavānanam ivāmbhojam ambhojam iva te mukham |
padmaṃ tāvat tavānveti mukham anyac ca tādṛśam |
asti ced astu tatkārīty asāv aniyamopamā ||
tvayyeva tvanmukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dṛśyate divi candramāḥ |
mayy evāsyā mukhaśrīr ity alam indor vikatthanaiḥ |
padme .pi sā yad asty evety asāvutprekṣitopamā ||
yadi kiṃcid bhavet padmaṃ subhru vibhrāntalocanam |
tat te mukhaśriyaṃ dhattām ity asāvadbhutopamā ||
indum apy anudhāvāmīty eṣā mohopamā smṛtā ||
kiṃ padmam antarbhrāntāli kiṃ te lolekṣaṇaṃ mukham |
atas tvanmukham evedam ity asau nirṇayopamā ||
ambhojam iva te vaktram iti śleṣopamā smṛtā ||
padmaṃ bahurajaś candraḥ kṣayī tābhyāṃ tavānanam |
samānam api sotsekam iti nindopamā smṛtā ||
candreṇa tvanmukhaṃ tulyam ity ācikhyāsu me manaḥ |
sa guṇo vāstu doṣo vety ācikhyāsopamāṃ viduḥ ||
na jātu śaktir indos te mukhena pratigarjitum |
na padmaṃ mukham evedaṃ na bhṛṅgau cakṣuṣī ime |
candrabimbād iva viṣaṃ candanād iva pāvakaḥ |
paruṣā vāg ito vaktrād ity asaṃbhāvitopamā ||
tava tanvaṅgi vadanam ity asau vikriyopamā ||
pūṣṇy ātapa ivāhnīva pūṣā vyomnīva vāsaraḥ |
vikramas tvayy adhāl lakṣmīm iti mālopamā matā ||
nalinyā iva tanvaṅgyās tasyāḥ padmam ivānanam |
nanu dvitīyo nāsty eva pārijātasya pādapaḥ ||
yad bruvanti smṛtā seyaṃ tulyayogopamā yathā ||
divo jāgarti rakṣāyai pulomārir bhuvo bhavān |
asurās tena hanyante sāvalepās tvayā nṛpāḥ ||
kāntyā candramasaṃ dhāmnā sūryaṃ dhairyeṇa cārṇavam |
na liṅgavacane bhinne na hīnādhikatāpi vā |
strīva gacchati ṣaṇḍho .yaṃ vakty eṣā strī pumān iva |
prāṇā iva priyo .yam me vidyā dhanam ivārjitam ||
alam aṃśumataḥ kakṣām āroḍhuṃ tejasā nṛpaḥ ||
ity evam ādau saubhāgyaṃ na jahāty eva jātucit |
asty eva kvacid udvegaḥ prayoge vāgvidāṃ yathā ||
bhartṛbhakto bhaṭaḥ śveva khadyoto bhāti bhānuvat ||
īdṛśaṃ varjyate sadbhiḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra cintyatām |
tasya muṣṇāti saubhāgyaṃ tasya kāntiṃ vilumpati |
tatpadavyām padaṃ dhatte tasya kakṣāṃ vigāhate |
bāhū late vasantaśrīs tvaṃ naḥ pratyakṣacāriṇī ||
mukhena mugdhaḥ so .py eṣa jano rāgamayaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
rūpakaṃ viṣamaṃ nāma lalitaṃ jāyate yathā ||
na mīlayati padmāni na nabho .py avagāhate |
atra saṃdarśyate yasmād viruddhaṃ nāma rūpakam ||
kāmadatvāc ca lokānām asi tvaṃ kalpapādapaḥ ||
kalpadrumaś ca kriyate tad idaṃ heturūpakam ||
na te sundari saṃvādīty etad ākṣeparūpakam ||
mukhendur api te caṇḍi māṃ nirdahati nirdayam |
naitan mukham idaṃ padmaṃ na netre bhramarāv imau |
etāni kesarāṇy eva naitā dantārciṣas tava ||
sarvavākyopakāraś cet tad āhur dīpakaṃ yathā ||
pavano dakṣiṇaḥ parṇaṃ jīrṇaṃ harati vīrudhāṃ |
kvāpi nītāḥ kuto .py āsann ānītā daivatarddhayaḥ ||
ity ādidīpakāny uktāny evaṃ madhyāntayor api |
mando gandhavahaḥ kṣāro vahnir induś ca jāyate |
calaṃ ca taḍitāṃ dāma balaṃ kusumadhanvanaḥ ||
mayāpi maraṇe cetas trayam etat samaṃ kṛtam ||
śuklaḥ śvetārciṣo vṛddhyai pakṣaḥ pañcaśarasya saḥ |
sa ca rāgasya rāgo .pi yūnāṃ ratyutsavaśriyaḥ ||
kriye viruddhe saṃyukte tad viruddhārthaṃ dīpakam ||
haraty ābhogam āśānāṃ gṛhṇāti jyotiṣāṃ gaṇam |
ādatte cādya me prāṇān asau jaladharāvalī ||
divi bhramanti jīmūtā bhuvi caite mataṃgajāḥ ||
atra dharmair abhinnānām abhrāṇāṃ dantināṃ tathā |
unmīlanti ca kandalyo dalanti kakubhāni ca ||
jitvā viśvaṃ bhavān atra viharaty avarodhanaiḥ |
viharaty apsarobhis te ripuvargo divaṃ gataḥ ||
pravṛttaiva yad ākṣiptā vṛttākṣepaḥ sa īdṛśaḥ ||
kim apāṅgam aparyāptam asmin karmaṇi manyase ||
satyaṃ bravīmi na tvaṃ māṃ draṣṭuṃ vallabha lapsyase |
tava tanvaṅgi mithyaiva rūḍham aṅgeṣu mārdavam |
yadi satyaṃ mṛdūny eva kim akāṇḍe rujanti mām ||
sundarī sā bhavaty evaṃ vivekaḥ kena jāyate |
prabhāmātraṃ hi taralaṃ dṛśyate na tadāśrayaḥ ||
bhruvau ca bhugne na tathāpy aduṣṭasyāsti me bhayam ||
sa eṣa kāraṇākṣepaḥ pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ bhiyaḥ |
dṛṣṭāś ca phullā niculā na mṛtā cāsmi kiṃ nv idam ||
na ciraṃ mama tāpāya tava yātrā bhaviṣyati |
yadi yāsyasi yātavyam alam āśaṅkayātra te ||
dhanaṃ ca bahu labhyaṃ te sukhaṃ kṣemaṃ ca vartmani |
na ca me prāṇasaṃdehas tathāpi priya mā sma gāḥ ||
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā kānta svavasthā tu niveditā ||
gaccha gacchasi cet kānta panthānaḥ santu te śivāḥ |
mamāpi janma tatraiva bhūyād yatra gato bhavān ||
yadi satyaiva yātrā te kāpy anyā mṛgyatāṃ tvayā |
gantā ced gaccha tūrṇaṃ te karṇau yānti purā ravāḥ |
nirgacchati mukhād vāṇī mā gā iti karomi kim ||
premṇaḥ prayāṇaṃ tvaṃ brūhi mayā tasyeṣṭam iṣyate ||
sahiṣye virahaṃ nātha dehy adṛśyāñjanaṃ mama |
yad aktanetrāṃ kandarpaḥ prahartā māṃ na paśyati ||
patyuḥ prasthānam ity āhur upāyākṣepam īdṛśam ||
pravṛttaiva prayāmīti vāṇī vallabha te mukhāt |

column3: citram ākrāntaviśvo .pi vikramas te na tṛpyati |
kadā vā dṛśyate tṛptir udīrṇasya havirbhujaḥ ||
na stūyase narendra tvaṃ dadāsīti kadācana |
svam eva matvā gṛhṇanti yatas tvaddhanam arthinaḥ ||
paśya gacchata evāstaṃ niyatiḥ kena laṅghyate ||
kaṭur bhavati karṇasya kāmināṃ pāpam īdṛśam ||
kṣiṇotu kāmaṃ śītāṃśuḥ kiṃ vasanto dunoti mām |
kumudāny api dāhāya kim ayaṃ kamalākaraḥ |
śabdopātte pratīte vā sādṛśye vastunor dvayoḥ |
tatra yad bhedakathanaṃ vyatirekaḥ sa kathyate ||
guṇais tulyo .si bhedas tu vapuṣaivedṛśena te ||
kārṣṇyaṃ piśaṅgatā cobhau yat pṛthag darśitāv iha ||
tvaṃ samudraś ca durvārau mahāsattvau satejasau |
ayaṃ tu yuvayor bhedaḥ sa jaḍātmā paṭur bhavān ||
sa eṣa śleṣarūpatvāt saśleṣa iti gṛhyatām |
sākṣepaś ca sahetuś ca darśyate tad api dvayam ||
sthitimān api dhīro .pi ratnānām ākaro .pi san |
tava kakṣāṃ na yāty eva malino makarālayaḥ ||
tvanmukhaṃ kamalaṃ ceti dvayor apy anayor bhidā |
bhramadbhramaram ambhojaṃ lolanetraṃ mukhaṃ tu te ||
dṛṣṭirodhitayā tulyaṃ bhinnam anyair adarśi tat ||
yatra svābhāvikatvaṃ vā vibhāvyaṃ sā vibhāvanā ||
uktaṃ ca surabhitvādi phalaṃ tat sā vibhāvanā ||
socchrayaḥ sthairyavān daivād eṣa labdho mayā drumaḥ ||

column3: sarve sādhāraṇā dharmāḥ pūrvatrānyatra tu dvayam ||
stanayor jaghanasyāpi madhye madhyaṃ priye tava |
asti nāstīti saṃdeho na me .dyāpi nivartate ||
nirṇetuṃ śakyam astīti madhyaṃ tava nitambini |
mātimātum aśakyo .pi yaśorāśir yad atra te ||
anyathotprekṣyate yatra tām utprekṣāṃ vidur yathā ||
snātuṃ pātuṃ bisāny attuṃ kariṇo jalagāhanam |
iti karṇotpalaṃ prāyas tava dṛṣṭyā vilaṅghyate ||
spṛśyate vā na vety evaṃ kavinotprekṣya varṇyate ||
limpates tamasaś cāsau dharmaḥ ko .tra samīkṣyate ||
yadi lepanam eveṣṭaṃ limpatir nāma ko .paraḥ |
sa eva dharmo dharmī cety anunmatto na bhāṣate ||
kartā yady upamānaṃ syān nyagbhūto .sau kriyāpade |
yo limpaty amunā tulyaṃ tama ity api śaṃsataḥ |
aṅgānīti na saṃbaddhaṃ so .pi mṛgyaḥ samo guṇaḥ ||
yathendur iva te vaktram iti kāntiḥ pratīyate |
na tathā limpater lepād anyad atra pratīyate ||
manye śaṅke dhruvaṃ prāyo nūnam ityevamādibhiḥ |
hetuś ca sūkṣmaleśau ca vācām uttamabhūṣaṇam |
nivartye ca vikārye ca hetutvaṃ tadapekṣayā |
prāpye tu karmaṇi prāyaḥ kriyāpekṣaiva hetutā ||
candraḥ pūrṇaś ca kāmena pānthadṛṣṭer viṣaṃ kṛtam ||
gato .stam arko bhātīndur yānti vāsāya pakṣiṇaḥ |
dehoṣmabhiḥ subodhaṃ te sakhi kāmāturaṃ manaḥ ||
kṣato mohaś cyutā tṛṣṇā kṛtaṃ puṇyāśrame manaḥ ||
vanāny amūni na gṛhāṇy etā nadyo na yoṣitaḥ |
mṛgā ime na dāyādās tan me nandati mānasam ||
muktaṃ tad anyatas tena so .py ahaṃ manasi kṣataḥ ||
kadā nau saṃgamo bhāvīty ākīrṇe vaktum akṣamam |
avagaccheyur ā jñātam aho śītānilaṃ vanam ||
ānandāśru pravṛttaṃ me kathaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva kanyakām |
leśam eke vidur nindāṃ stutiṃ vā leśataḥ kṛtām ||
yuvaiṣa guṇavān rājā yogyas te patir ūrjitaḥ |
raṇotsave manaḥ saktaṃ yasya kāmotsavād api ||
capalo nirdayaś cāsau janaḥ kiṃ tena me sakhi |
yathāsaṃkhyam iti proktaṃ saṃkhyānaṃ krama ity api ||
ūrjasvi rūḍhāhaṃkāraṃ yuktotkarṣaṃ ca tat trayam ||
adya yā mama govinda jātā tvayi gṛhāgate |
ity āha yuktaṃ viduro nānyatas tādṛśī dhṛtiḥ |
somaḥ sūryo marudbhūmir vyoma hotānalo jalam |
iti rūpāṇy atikramya tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ deva ke vayam ||
iti sākṣātkṛte deve rājño yad rātavarmaṇaḥ |
prītiprakāśanaṃ tac ca preya ity avagamyatām ||
mṛte .ti pretya saṃgantuṃ yayā me maraṇaṃ matam |
saivāvantī mayā labdhā katham atraiva janmani ||
prāk prītir darśitā seyaṃ ratiḥ śṛṅgāratāṃ gatā |
nigṛhya keśeṣv ākṛṣṭā kṛṣṇā yenāgrato mama |
so .yaṃ duḥśāsanaḥ pāpo labdhaḥ kiṃ jīvati kṣaṇam ||
ity āruhya parāṃ koṭiṃ krodho raudrātmatāṃ gataḥ |
bhīmasya paśyataḥ śatrum ity etad rasavadvacaḥ ||
ajitvā sārṇavām urvīm aniṣṭvā vividhair makhaiḥ |
adatvā cārtham arthibhyo bhaveyaḥ pārthivaḥ katham ||
śākhāś ca mandirāṇy eṣāṃ citraṃ nandanaśākhinām ||
iha tv aṣṭarasāyattā rasavattā smṛtā girām ||
apakartāham asmīti hṛdi te mā sma bhūd bhayam |
vimukheṣu na me khaḍgaḥ prahartuṃ jātu vāñchati ||
iti muktaḥ paro yuddhe niruddho darpaśalinā |
artham iṣṭam anākhyāya sākṣāt tasyaiva siddhaye |
tam ahaṃ vārayiṣyāmi yuvābhyāṃ svairam āsyatām ||
mānam asyā nirākartuṃ pādayor me patiṣyataḥ |
āśayasya vibhūter vā yan mahatvam anuttamam |
udāttaṃ nāma taṃ prāhur alaṃkāraṃ manīṣibhiḥ ||
guroḥ śasanam atyetuṃ na śaśāka sa rāghavaḥ |
suvyañjitam iti proktaṃ udāttadvayam apy adaḥ ||
na pañceṣu smaras tasya sahasraṃ patriṇām iti ||
candanaṃ candrikā mando gandhavāhaś ca dakṣiṇaḥ |
seyam agnimayī sṛṣṭir mayi śītā parān prati ||
rājā harati lokasya hṛdayaṃ mṛdubhiḥ karaiḥ ||
rājñā pradoṣo mām ittham apriyaṃ kiṃ na bādhate ||
prāg eva darśitāḥ śleṣā darśyante ke canāpare ||
viruddhakarmā cāsty anyaḥ śleṣo niyamavān api ||
dṛśo dūtyaś ca karṣanti kāntābhiḥ preṣitāḥ priyān ||
nistriṃśatvam asāv eva dhanuṣy evāsya vakratā |
śareṣv eva narendrasya mārgaṇatvaṃ ca vartate ||
padmānām eva daṇḍeṣu kaṇṭakas tvayi rakṣati |
dakṣaḥ prajāpatiś cāsīt svāmī śaktidharaś ca saḥ ||
na kaṭhoraṃ na vā tīkṣṇam āyudhaṃ puṣpadhanvanaḥ |
tathāpy eṣā tapobhaṅgaṃ vidhātuṃ vedhaso .py alam ||
na baddhā bhrūkuṭir nāpi sphurito daśanacchadaḥ |
na ca raktābhavad dṛṣṭir jitaṃ ca dviṣatāṃ kulam ||
na rathā na ca mātaṅgā na hayā na ca pattayaḥ |
ekacakro ratho yantā vikalo viṣamā hayāḥ |
ākrāmaty eva tejasvī tathāpy arko nabhastalam ||
ayam eva kramo .nyeṣāṃ bhedānām api kalpane ||
yamaḥ kubero varuṇaḥ sahasrākṣo bhavān api |
kṣaṇadvayaṃ na tiṣṭhanti ghanārabdhāny api svayam ||
rāgeṇa punar ākrāntaṃ jāyate jagatāṃ manaḥ ||
natanābhi vapuḥ strīṇāṃ kaṃ na haraty unnatastanam ||
api te rūpam asmākaṃ tanvi tāpāya kalpate ||
yadi nindann iva stauti vyājastutir asau smrtā |
doṣābhāsā guṇā eva labhante hy atra saṃnidhim ||
tvayā rājñāpi saiveyaṃ jitā mā bhūn madas tava ||
puṃsaḥ purāṇād ācchidya śrīs tvayā paribhujyate |
rājann ikṣākuvaṃśasya kim idaṃ tava yujyate ||
ahaṅkāraḥ parāṃ koṭim ārohati kutas tava ||
sad asad vā nidarśyeta yadi tat syān nidarśanam ||
udayann eṣa savitā padmeṣv arpayati śriyam |
arthānāṃ yo vinimayaḥ parivṛttis tu sā smṛtā ||
saha dīrghā mama śvāsair imāḥ samprati rātrayaḥ |
pāṇḍurāś ca mamaivāṅgeḥ saha tāś candrabhūṣaṇāh ||
patanti ca samaṃ teṣām asubhir malayānilāḥ ||
ity udāhṛtayo dattāḥ sahokter atra kāś cana ||
kriyate parivṛtteś ca kiṃ cid rūpanidarśanam ||
śleṣaḥ sarvāsu puṣṇāti prāyo vakroktiṣu śriyam |
bhinnaṃ dvidhā svabhāvoktir vakroktiś ceti vāṅmayam ||
tad bhāvikam iti prāhuḥ prabandhaviṣayaṃ guṇam |
bhāvaḥ kaver abhiprāyaḥ kāvyeṣv āsiddhi saṃsthitaḥ ||
bhāvāyattām idaṃ sarvam iti tad bhāvikaṃ viduḥ ||
panthāḥ sa eṣa vivṛtaḥ parimāṇavṛttyā saṃhṛtya vistaram anantam alaṅkriyāṇām |
vācām atītya viṣayaṃ parivartamānān abhyāsa eva vivarītum alaṃ viśeṣān ||
ity ācāryadaṇḍinaḥ kṛtau kāvyādarśe .rthālaṅkāravibhāgo nāma dvitīyo paricchedaḥ ||
